content.overview: Article 124C — Omitted / Repealed. Not current working law.
content.study:
Article 124C (“Power of Parliament to make law. ––Parliament may, by law, regulate the procedure for the appointment of Chief Justice of India and other Judges of the Supreme”) of the Constitution of India has been omitted by constitutional amendment.

Status: Repealed / Omitted.
It is not current working law in the territory of India.

Examination Instruction:
When answering university or judicial service questions, note that Article 124C is omitted and identify the living constitutional or statutory provision that currently governs the subject matter.
